title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
reason: Chinese prosecutors seeking to confiscate 61,800 BTC tied to a $5.7B fraud, following a UK court ruling, is a significant, sourced legal development affecting a large bitcoin stash.

sources.summary: Chinese prosecutors are seeking to confiscate more than 61,800 Bitcoin tied to a $5.7 billion fraud scheme, days after a U.K. court ruled Chinese law governs victims’ claims to the coins.
